newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello urges Australians to buy shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello urges Australians to buy shares.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday the Federal government was urging Australians to invest in listed Australian companies.
"We want to encourage Australians to buy shares," Costello told a meeting of the Young Liberals.
Costello said the government had gone some way to encouraging share ownership by doubling the tax deduction for participation in employee share plans.
"Widespread shareholding amongst Australians is a way of securing each Australian an interest in the economic development of this country," he said.
The Treasurer earlier said Australia had a strong-growth, low inflation economy.
